description: Acceptance evidence for the six-server-as-default standard-deployment plan (eval3_optim3.md §二十). Collected on the same 8xH200 container, checkpoint, and venvs used throughout b/d/libplus/libero_egl_slut.md.
topology: six servers (SERVER_INSTANCES_PER_GPU=3), GPU 0/1 for servers, GPU 2-7 for EGL clients

runs.name: std_six_server_smoke

command_env.note: NUM_TRIALS_PER_TASK left at its inherited-shell value of 1 (script default for smoke is 5; this run happened to inherit 1 from a stale exported var, which is itself informative: the launcher must be run in a clean shell or with NUM_TRIALS_PER_TASK explicitly set)

runs.verdict: PASS - six model servers started, all six healthchecks passed, six EGL clients each rendered+inferred on an isolated physical GPU, all 8 shards produced a result JSON, aggregate_std_results.py summed correctly, threshold gate (50%) PASS.

runs.name: std_six_server_medium_regression
runs.purpose: First real-model, multi-shard-per-client, multi-episode-per-shard regression for the standard-LIBERO six-server launcher. Each of the 6 clients sequentially processes 4 shards (one per suite), 5 episodes per shard, i.e. 20 episodes per client back-to-back in one EGL-rendering child process -- the exact failure mode ('SIGABRT after ~4 episodes') that motivated this whole investigation.
runs.verdict: PASS - 120/120 episodes completed with a written result JSON (no lost episodes), 0 SIGABRT/SIGSEGV/CRASHED across all 24 client log files, aggregate_std_results.py crash_task_count=0, overall SR 92.5% (policy-quality number, not a topology-stability metric).
runs.note_on_success_rate: The per-suite SR spread (80%-100%) reflects normal task-to-task policy variance, not any renderer/topology defect: every episode that started also finished and wrote a result.

runs.name: libero_plus_six_server_default_smoke

command_env.note: SERVER_INSTANCES_PER_GPU intentionally left UNSET to confirm the new default (3, six servers) takes effect without any explicit override

runs.purpose: Regression-confirm that after flipping the launcher default from SERVER_INSTANCES_PER_GPU=1 to 3, the LIBERO-plus launcher still boots six servers and six clients correctly with zero explicit configuration.

result.leaderboard_summary_percent: all 0.0 (MAX_STEPS_OVERRIDE=20 is too short to finish any task and libero_spatial task ids are outside every LIBERO-plus perturbation category, so this run intentionally cannot be read as a policy-quality signal)

runs.verdict: PASS - printed 'Server GPUs: 0,1 (3 instances/GPU)' confirming the new default, six healthchecks passed, six clients completed without any SIGABRT/SIGSEGV/CRASHED string in their logs, six result JSON files were written.

cross_reference.prior_ab_evidence: asset/libero_egl_topology_ab_results.json (24 task / 120 episode two-server vs six-server A/B: six-server client phase 28.1% faster, end-to-end 20.3% faster, both 0 crashes/0 missing results)
